verdicts.reason: A breaks reading order and hierarchy: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below its own headline, the URL and venue are jammed into a cramped stack under the headline, and the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill mixed in with the badges at the bottom. That leaves the CTA buried and a large dead area around the phone. B keeps the original order and a prominent RSVP button, but the phone is shoved off-axis to the right, the QR placeholder sits right next to the URL line, and the left-aligned date/badge block doesn't line up with the centred header.
